'''Grossh''' was a [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] who was the one of the leaders of the [[White Maw]] pirate organization during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. In [[3642 BBY]], he and his White Maw minions engaged the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]], who was there to find the reactor, but they were all killed.<ref name="Position of Power" />
